comments.comment: RE-SAN9PK-0113 [confirmed]: automatic code 25 requires a shared action gate, then nonempty target, origin and actor lists; actors are filtered to current effective intelligence 45..115 before the common selector creates the same command as the interactive path.

RE-SAN9PK-0113 [confirmed]: automatic code 26 mirrors code 25's shared action gate and target/origin/actor pipeline; its target collector adds disorder-specific exclusions and converges on the interactive command constructor.

RE-SAN9PK-0113 [confirmed]: false-report submission reserves participants, stores rnd(100, kind 0, stable target/actor seed) in a type-25 event, attaches it to the source unit and marks the source task active; no funds or food are deducted.

RE-SAN9PK-0113 [confirmed]: disorder submission reserves participants, stores rnd(100, kind 0, stable target/actor seed) in a type-26 event, attaches it to the source unit and marks the source task active; no funds or food are deducted.

RE-SAN9PK-0113 [confirmed]: advisor result compares only whether same-seed rnd(actual threshold) and rnd(counselor accuracy) are zero or nonzero; equal truth values return result 1, different values return result 3.

RE-SAN9PK-0113 [confirmed]: execution recomputes formula 6 live and succeeds iff the stored 0..99 roll is lower. Success applies status 4 for 5+rnd(3) days and intelligence growth; failure only decreases inter-force relation by 1+rnd(3). All outcomes write strategy proficiency through the shared path.

RE-SAN9PK-0113 [confirmed]: execution recomputes formula 7 live and succeeds iff the stored 0..99 roll is lower. Success applies status 5 for 20-isqrt(executed target intelligence) days, lowers morale by 1+rnd(3), and attempts intelligence growth; failure only decreases relation. All outcomes write strategy proficiency.

RE-SAN9PK-0113 [confirmed]: common unit-status writer handles status codes 4..8, sets the status flag, keeps the maximum remaining duration, performs status-specific target/command cleanup, refreshes the unit and may teach tactic 22 to target members.
